Texel, day 4. Rented bikes in Den Burg (€11/day each), Salma and I did the loop to De Cocksdorp and the lighthouse, 41 km, headwind both ways somehow. Ate smoked eel on the dyke. Salma told me she's pregnant, due in February, I'm the first one she told after Karim. Cried on the dyke. Auntie Yasmina. Haven't opened the laptop once, checked Slack on my phone twice (Atlas go-live is next Monday, I'm human). Sunburnt nose. Sea at 18 degrees, went in anyway.
